article.title: Pawnee’s right as to extraordinary expenses incurred.
article.content: Thepawnee is entitled to receive from the pawnor extraordinary expenses incurred by him for the preservation of the goods pledged.
article.html:
175Pawnee’s right as to extraordinary expenses incurred.

Section 175 · Chapter IX · Bailments of Pledges · page 42 of the Act

Thepawnee is entitled to receive from the pawnor extraordinary expenses incurred by him for the preservation of the goods pledged.
